title: Leo’s Cardboard Rocket
subtitle: One brown box, two kitchen colanders, and a trip to the moon.
end_subtitle: Leo flew all the way to the moon and made it back in time for pajamas.
cover_prompt: 4:3 landscape children's picture-book cover illustration. In the living room, a 4-year-old child sits inside a cardboard moving box decorated with crayon stars, wearing a kitchen colander helmet, while a glowing silver moon rocket rises in a soft imagination cloud behind them. Clean hand-drawn ink linework, gentle watercolor fills, no text in image.

pages.title: The Living Room Launchpad
text: Leo had a cardboard box. Leo had a colander helmet.
And Leo had a very important mission before bedtime.
pages.real_prompt: 4:3 landscape illustration of Leo standing on the living room rug beside an ordinary brown cardboard box, a metal kitchen colander, and a small red wooden toy train. Clean hand-drawn ink linework, gentle watercolor fills, no text.
pages.imaginary_prompt: Matching 4:3 landscape angle: Commander Leo in a silver space helmet stands on a gleaming lunar launchpad beside a towering white-and-gold Saturn rocket, with a red rover parked nearby. Clean hand-drawn ink linework, gentle watercolor fills, no text.
pages.flap_hint: Lift the flap to see what the cardboard box really is!

pages.title: Countdown Check
text: Leo climbed inside and tapped the cardboard flaps.
“Engines ready?” he whispered. THREE, TWO, ONE... BLAST OFF!
pages.real_prompt: 4:3 landscape illustration of Leo sitting inside the cardboard box on the living room rug, peering over the cardboard flap with a flashlight in hand. Clean hand-drawn ink linework, gentle watercolor fills, no text.
pages.imaginary_prompt: Matching 4:3 landscape angle: Commander Leo sits in the glowing cockpit of a starship as golden thrusters rumble beneath the rocket, lifting above fluffy clouds toward a starry sky. Clean hand-drawn ink linework, gentle watercolor fills, no text.
pages.flap_hint: Lift the flap to launch into orbit!
